from collections import Counter
def transform2(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)

        if not dot(i,c1): g[i][c1]=2
    # interior lines: >=4 interior dots -> fill len-1 gaps
